projects.title: HR Software Management System (AWS Chime, AWS Forecast, AWS Sagemaker)
projects.description:
- Led team in developing end-to-end electronic-HR management system for graduate thesis project 
- Implemented features such as secure login/logout, user profile, embedded audio/video call, employee sentiment analysis, performance tracking
- Solution deployed to AWS cloud for scalability and reliability

projects.title: Orion Ecommerce Platform (ReactJS, MongoDB,  NodeJS, Heroku, PayPal API)
projects.description:
- Designed and engineered a comprehensive ecommerce website with product lists, secure purchasing, and ratings and reviews
- Webpage developed in ReactJS and integrated into the Heroku Server with backend storage in Mongo Atlas Database using Mongoose ODM and secure transactions using PayPal API
